recommendation.cpu_generous: No GPU detected, but RAM is generous. Classic ML with no practical memory limits. CPU training of small transformer models is possible, but remains orders of magnitude slower than GPU — for serious LLM fine-tuning, a cloud GPU is still recommended.

breaker.title: Circuit Breaker
breaker.hint: When an agent in a delegation chain starts failing — a storm of policy denials, a burst of incidents or a runaway loop — the breaker halts the whole chain (OWASP ASI08). It never closes by itself: an admin resumes or terminates the chain.

breaker.halted_empty: No chain is halted right now.
breaker.using_defaults: Built-in defaults are in use. Saving stores them as your organization's settings.
breaker.using_org: Your organization's settings are in use.
breaker.threshold_rule: A chain trips when a count reaches its threshold within the window.
breaker.disabled_warning: While disabled, failing agents are not stopped automatically.
breaker.confirm_disable: Turn the circuit breaker off? Failing agents will no longer be stopped automatically. This change is recorded in the audit log.
breaker.reset_defaults_hint: Fill the form with the built-in defaults (not saved yet)
breaker.overrides_hint: An override applies to chains started by that agent (the root of the chain) — e.g. a busy support agent can get a higher attempt limit.

help.window_seconds: How far back events are counted
help.max_denials: Actions refused by policy — catches an agent pushing against its limits
help.max_attempts: Every action check — catches a runaway loop

registry.title: Tool Registry
registry.hint: Which tools, MCP servers and SDKs your agents may use, pinned to a version and manifest digest (OWASP ASI04). A tool that changes after approval is flagged as drifted.
registry.load_failed: Could not load the Tool Registry.
registry.mode_monitor_hint: Nothing is blocked except explicitly blocked tools. Every new tool an agent uses is added here as pending, so the registry fills itself from real traffic. Drift is flagged and raises an incident.
registry.mode_enforce_hint: Only approved tools run. Pinned tools must report a matching version / manifest digest; a drifted tool is refused until re-approved.
registry.confirm_enforce: Switch to enforce? Only approved tools will run. {{count}} entries are not approved yet.

behavior.title: Behavior Monitor
behavior.hint: Each agent is compared with its own recent behaviour: new tools, bursts of activity, runs of denials, unusual hours (OWASP ASI10). In enforce mode a strongly deviating agent is quarantined until an admin releases it.
behavior.load_failed: Could not load the behaviour monitor.
behavior.confirm_release: Release this agent? Its actions will be evaluated normally again.
behavior.mode_monitor_hint: Deviations are recorded here; nothing is blocked.
behavior.mode_enforce_hint: An agent whose score reaches the threshold is quarantined: all its actions are refused and the chains it started are halted.
behavior.confirm_enforce: Switch to enforce? Agents whose score reaches the threshold will be quarantined automatically and every action they attempt will be refused until an admin releases them.
behavior.field_min_samples: Attempts before a baseline is trusted
behavior.help_threshold: Sum of signal weights that triggers quarantine
behavior.help_min_samples: Until then new tools and unusual hours are not flagged
behavior.help_baseline_days: How much history forms the baseline

injection.title: Prompt Injection
injection.hint: Instructions hidden in data can hijack an agent's goal (OWASP ASI01). Tool arguments are scanned on every check, tool outputs on every record. In enforce mode an injected argument is refused, and an injected output taints its chain: further actions in it need a human approval until an admin clears the taint.
injection.load_failed: Could not load the injection guard.
injection.confirm_clear: Clear the taint? Actions in this chain will no longer need a human approval because of the injected output.
injection.tester_placeholder: Paste a web page, e-mail or tool output…
injection.truncated: Only the first 100,000 characters were scanned.
injection.mode_monitor_hint: Detections are recorded here and noted in the decision reason; nothing is blocked. An injected tool output raises an incident.
injection.mode_enforce_hint: An argument with an injection is refused. An injected tool output taints the chain: every further action in it needs a human approval until an admin clears it.
injection.confirm_enforce: Switch to enforce? Tool calls whose arguments contain an injection will be refused, and every chain that receives an injected tool output will need human approval for each further action until an admin clears it.
injection.help_threshold: Lower catches more, with more false positives

codeexec.title: Code Execution
codeexec.hint: An agent that can reach a shell, an interpreter or a database can be steered into running code nobody intended (OWASP ASI05). Every tool call's arguments are checked for reverse shells, pipe-to-shell downloads, eval, SQL injection, path traversal and similar shapes.
codeexec.load_failed: Could not load the code-execution guard.
codeexec.review_only: Code tool call sent for review
codeexec.mode_monitor_hint: Findings are recorded here and noted in the decision reason; nothing is blocked.
codeexec.mode_enforce_hint: Critical findings are refused; high findings and calls to code tools wait for a human approval; medium findings are recorded.
codeexec.confirm_enforce: Switch to enforce? Calls with critical code (reverse shells, pipe-to-shell, disk wipes…) will be refused, and calls with high-risk code or to code tools will wait for a human approval.
codeexec.approve_code_tools: Every code-tool call needs a human approval (enforce)
codeexec.approve_code_tools_hint: Turn off only if code tools run in an isolated sandbox; critical findings are still refused.
codeexec.code_tools_hint: Glob patterns such as shell.* or *.exec. Arguments of these tools are read as commands.

memory.title: Memory Integrity
memory.hint: Whatever lands in a knowledge base or in an agent's memory comes back into prompts later (OWASP ASI06). RAG documents are scanned chunk by chunk on upload; agents attest each memory write and verify retrieved memory before using it. Only trusted content reaches a prompt.
memory.confirm_trust_doc: Trust this document? All its chunks, including the flagged ones, will be returned by search again.
memory.confirm_revoke_doc: Revoke this document? Its chunks stop being returned by search; nothing is deleted.
memory.confirm_revoke_entry: Revoke this memory entry? Agents will stop using it at their next verification.
memory.mode_off_hint: Nothing is checked; everything is trusted.
memory.mode_monitor_hint: Findings are recorded; nothing is quarantined or rejected.
memory.mode_enforce_hint: Poisoned chunks and memory entries are quarantined and kept out of prompts; writes into foreign namespaces, by non-active agents or from tainted chains are rejected or quarantined.
memory.confirm_enforce: Switch to enforce? Poisoned RAG chunks and memory entries will be quarantined and kept out of prompts, and writes into foreign namespaces will be rejected.
memory.shared_hint: Every agent may write and read these. Its own namespace agent.<id> is always allowed.
memory.ttl_hint: After this an entry verifies as expired (1–365)

a2a.title: Agent Messages
a2a.hint: Agents that talk to each other can be impersonated, replayed or fed altered messages (OWASP ASI07). Each message is registered with an envelope signed by the sender's key and verified again by the recipient before it acts: identity, freshness, single use, allowed route and unaltered content.
a2a.confirm_release: Release this message? The recipient will be allowed to act on it.
a2a.channels_hint: Routes allowed in addition to agents sharing a delegation chain. Disabled channels stay in the list for the audit trail.
a2a.confirm_disable: Disable this channel? In enforce mode these agents will no longer be able to message each other unless they share a chain.
a2a.mode_monitor_hint: Problems are recorded and messages still pass - except replayed nonces and altered payloads, which are never usable.
a2a.mode_enforce_hint: Any failed check rejects the message and raises an incident; a poisoned payload is quarantined until an admin releases it.
a2a.confirm_enforce: Switch to enforce? Messages with an invalid signature, a reused nonce, a stale timestamp or no allowed route will be rejected, and poisoned payloads quarantined. Make sure the channels your agents need exist first.
a2a.allow_same_chain: Agents in the same delegation chain may message each other
a2a.allow_same_chain_hint: Off: only explicit channels are allowed.
a2a.help_message_ttl_seconds: After this the recipient can no longer accept it

identity.title: Agent Identity
identity.hint: Each agent authenticates with its own key (header X-Agent-Key). A key works only on agent endpoints, only for its own agent, and never opens admin pages. Actions run on behalf of the agent's owner, or an admin if it has none.
identity.shown_once: Shown only once - store it in the agent's secret store now.
identity.confirm_rotate: Issue a new key for this agent? The current key keeps working until the grace period ends.
identity.confirm_revoke: Revoke this agent's key now? It will be refused immediately until a new key is issued.
identity.confirm_require: Require agent keys? Agents that still call Provenza with a user's token will be refused on check, record, delegate, messages, memory and the gateway. Make sure every agent has its key first.
identity.require_hint: A user's session can no longer call check, record, delegate, messages, memory or the gateway in an agent's name. The UI keeps working.
identity.grace_hint: How long the old key keeps working after a rotation (0–1440)

gateway.title: AI Gateway
gateway.hint: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint for agents. Point an agent's base URL here and use its own key: every call is checked against its allowed models, the Prompt Firewall (PII masked before it leaves), prompt-injection in tool messages, rate limits, and the answer is checked for injected instructions and dangerous code.
gateway.connect_hint: The key is the agent's key from Agent Identity (sent as Bearer or X-Agent-Key). Streaming is not supported yet.
gateway.routes_hint: Which connection serves a model name. A pattern such as gpt-4o* is allowed; an exact name wins over a pattern. The agent must also have the model in its allowed models.
gateway.routes_empty: No routes - the gateway serves no model yet.
gateway.confirm_disable: Disable this route? Agents asking for this model will get 'model not routed'.
gateway.enabled_hint: Off: every gateway call is refused.
gateway.scan_output_hint: Scan answers for injected instructions (ASI01) and critical code (ASI05); in enforce mode such an answer is replaced.

queue.title: Queue & Retention
queue.hint: AI requests run in a background queue. A request that waits too long is not sent late: it expires. A request delivered to the worker twice is processed once. Requests nobody approves expire, and encrypted raw prompts can be wiped after a retention period. A sweep enforces this every 5 minutes.
queue.sweeps_empty: No sweep has changed anything yet.
queue.queue_ttl_hint: A queued request that has not started by then expires instead of running late (60–86400)
queue.approval_ttl_hint: A request nobody approves or rejects by then expires (1–720)
queue.retention_hint: Only the encrypted original is wiped; the masked text stays for the audit trail (1–3650)
queue.confirm_retention: Turn on retention? Encrypted raw prompts older than this will be wiped permanently at the next sweep; the masked text and the audit trail stay.
queue.check_retention_hint: Verdicts of /actions/check older than this are deleted, except those an action or approval refers to (1–3650)
queue.content_retention_hint: Arguments, outputs, prompts and answers are erased; who did what, when and the verdict stay for the audit trail and the charts (1–3650)

byok.title: Encryption Keys
byok.hint: Connection keys, raw prompts and directory passwords are encrypted. With BYOK the organization gets its own data key, wrapped by a key you control - the server master key, your HashiCorp Vault or your AWS KMS. Revoke it on your side and Provenza can no longer read the data within 5 minutes; shred it here and nobody can.
byok.queued: Re-encryption runs in the background; refresh to follow it.
byok.confirm_disable: Turn BYOK off? All secrets are re-encrypted with the server key; the organization keys are retired.
byok.provider_local_hint: Per-organization key, rotation and shredding without an external service.
byok.provider_vault_transit_hint: The key encryption key never leaves your Vault.
byok.provider_aws_kms_hint: The key encryption key never leaves your AWS account; the organization is bound as encryption context.
byok.aws_missing: Needs boto3 on the server (pip install boto3).
byok.new_key_hint: A new data key is created, wrapped and unwrapped once to prove the key provider works, then every existing secret of the organization is re-encrypted with it. Secrets are stored encrypted; they are never shown again.
byok.confirm_rotate: Create a new data key and re-encrypt all secrets with it? The current key is retired but stays readable.
byok.confirm_enable: Enable BYOK and re-encrypt all secrets of the organization with its own key?
byok.shred_hint: Wipes every wrapped data key of the organization. Everything encrypted with them - connection keys, raw prompts, directory passwords - becomes unreadable for good. Values still on the server key are not affected. This cannot be undone.
byok.confirm_shred: Last chance: shred all organization keys? The data they protect will be lost permanently.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.hint: Requirements of the EU AI Act, GDPR, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF and the OWASP Agentic Top 10, checked against what Provenza actually knows. What only a person can confirm (documents, procedures) is attested here, with a link to the evidence. A pointer for orientation, not legal advice.
compliance.att_note: What was checked, by whom, where the evidence is
compliance.att_bad_url: Use an https:// link or a path in Provenza
compliance.reports_hint: A report is a frozen snapshot with a SHA-256 fingerprint; the report page checks that it was not altered and prints to PDF.
compliance.integrity_bad: CONTENT DOES NOT MATCH ITS FINGERPRINT
compliance.disclaimer: Generated by Provenza from its own records and recorded attestations. References are pointers for orientation, not legal advice.

obs.title: Agent observability
obs.hint: What your agents are doing right now: every policy decision and incident, streamed live. Only metadata is shown (agent, tool, verdict, guard codes, timing) — never arguments, outputs or reasons.
obs.no_data: No agent activity in this window.
obs.click_filter: Click to filter by this agent
obs.key_revoked_hint: This agent cannot call Provenza until a new key is issued
obs.no_content: no content stored for this event
obs.pii_note: PII masked; originals only on an admin's audited request
obs.reveal_hint: Admins only. Recorded in the audit log.
obs.reveal_prompt: Show this event WITHOUT PII masking? The request is recorded in the audit log. Reason:
obs.unmasked: UNMASKED — recorded in the audit log
obs.no_events_window: no agent activity in the selected window
